legend.ridge_line: 虚线棕：仅依据陆地形状计算的候选内陆高地轴，非正式山脉
legend.highland_point: 棕圆：远离海岸的研究点，未设实测海拔
legend.shoreward_arrows: 浅蓝：内陆指向岸边的候选径流扇区，尚未通过坡降验证、不是河流
legend.edge_outline: 现行B16候选海陆轮廓，非正式经纬海图

research_conventions: WGS84-like work longitude and latitude not accepted as official coordinates
Ridge candidate = maximal interior distance and longest interior ray along sampled angles; NOT measured geomorphology
Potential shoreward corridors = straight interior traces to distinct coastal sectors; NOT rivers or certified divides
Separate islands have no cross-strait overland flow
Fields for true altitude, river names, basin area, precipitation, soil, city positions remain null until world canon explicitly determined
